plugin_description: Load on-demand Agent Skills from configured folders and expose them to chat and workspace turns.
empty: No skills are available in the configured roots.
no_paths_hint: Set TSUKAIMA_SKILLS_PATHS or add skill roots in the plugin config.
config_paths_hint: Directories containing skill folders (each with a SKILL.md). Relative paths resolve against the server working directory.
config_disabled_hint: Skill names to hide from the catalog and tools.
config_scope_hint: Who can see and use skills that do not set an override.
config_everyone_skills_hint: Skill names usable by everyone even when the default scope is admin-only.
config_admin_skills_hint: Skill names restricted to administrators even when the default scope is everyone.
config_surfaces_hint: Conversation surfaces that receive the skill catalog and tools (chat, workspace).
config_allow_resources_hint: Allow the model to read text files bundled inside a skill folder.
config_max_catalog_chars_hint: Maximum characters rendered for the skill catalog in turn context (500–8000).
config_refresh_interval_seconds_hint: How often stale skill directories are rescanned in the background (5–3600).
